Gold Purity Testing

Gold Purity Testing in Delhi — Free German Karat Meter Test in South Extension

Free gold purity testing in South Delhi — German Karat Meter, exact karat on screen, zero damage to your jewellery. No obligation to sell.

📞 Call +91 9990780499 💬 WhatsApp Us 📍 Get Directions

Why the Test Method Decides Your Price

Purity is the single biggest factor in your payout, and the old touchstone-and-acid method only estimates it — while scratching your jewellery. Our German Karat Meter measures the exact metal composition and displays it, for example 22K = 91.6%, with your jewellery completely undamaged. Read the full comparison: German Karat Meter vs the old purity test.

What the Test Tells You

The reading shows the karat and the percentage of gold and alloy metals in the piece — hallmarked or not. With exact purity and an accurate weight, your valuation becomes simple arithmetic at the day's rate, which you can verify on your own phone. Even if you sell elsewhere later, you leave knowing exactly what you hold.

Free, In Front of You, No Obligation

Testing at our South Extension branch is completely free — a single piece or a full set — and the item is returned exactly as brought if you choose not to sell. There is no charge and no pressure; the number is yours to think over.

How It Works
